title: Policy inheritance
summary: The change introduces inherited policies, resolves the effective value at enrollment time, exposes it through the API, and verifies the behavior.

sections.title: Introduce the policy inheritance model
sections.explanation: Start with the contracts shared by the resolver and its callers. A policy may inherit from one parent and records whether a value is explicit.

sections.title: Resolve the effective policy
sections.explanation: The resolver walks the parent chain and returns the first explicit value, keeping inheritance logic out of consumers.

sections.title: Apply inheritance during enrollment
sections.explanation: Enrollment now asks for the effective policy before creating the device record.

sections.title: Expose the effective policy through the API
sections.explanation: The response boundary reports the resolved value and its source so clients do not need to reproduce inheritance rules.

sections.title: Verify inheritance behavior
sections.explanation: Resolver coverage establishes precedence, while enrollment coverage proves the effective value reaches a real consumer.

sections.title: Update supporting metadata
sections.explanation: The package description is updated after the behavioral change; it is useful context but not where review should begin.
